Mutable MAX_FREE_SUPPLY = 1420, cap for free mints, owner-settable.

Public constant MAX_FREE_MULTIMINT = 10, per-transaction free mint limit.
Mutable PRICE = 0.01 ETH per token, owner-settable.
URI extension string appended to tokenURI output.
Counters.Counter tracking minted supply for totalSupply().
Boolean gate enabling/disabling minting.

Public payable nonReentrant free mint; validates sale active, free supply cap, max supply and multimint, then mints in a loop.
View returning supplyCounter.current().
Owner-only toggling of saleIsActive.

edges.reason: User-supplied mint count parameter is consumed by mint().
User-supplied freeMint count parameter is consumed by freeMint().
Parameter is written into the saleIsActive state variable.
Base URI parameter flows into the base implementation call.
Extension URI parameter is written into extensionURI.
Token id parameter flows into tokenURI().
Price parameter is written into PRICE.
Parameter is written into MAX_FREE_SUPPLY.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in mint().
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in freeMint().
withdraw() relies on msg.sender equality with _owner() via onlyOwner.
setSaleIsActive() is guarded by onlyOwner dependent on msg.sender.
setBaseURI() is guarded by onlyOwner dependent on msg.sender.
setExtensionURI() is guarded by onlyOwner dependent on msg.sender.
setPrice() is guarded by onlyOwner dependent on msg.sender.
increaseFreeMintSupply() is guarded by onlyOwner dependent on msg.sender.
Constructor passes msg.sender as the initial owner of the delegated NFT.
MAX_SUPPLY participates in unchecked-style bound arithmetic totalSupply()+count-1 in mint().
MAX_MULTIMINT bounds the count in mint() and affects the value computation.
PRICE multiplies count in the msg.value>=PRICE*count check in mint().
MAX_FREE_SUPPLY is compared against totalSupply()+count-1 in freeMint().
MAX_FREE_MULTIMINT bounds the count in freeMint().
supplyCounter is incremented inside the mint loop.
supplyCounter is incremented inside the freeMint loop.
saleIsActive gate controls whether mint() proceeds.
saleIsActive gate controls whether freeMint() proceeds.
mint() calls the internal _mint helper.
freeMint() calls the internal _mint helper.
mint() writes supplyCounter through increment().
freeMint() writes supplyCounter through increment().
mint() calls totalSupply() in its supply checks.
freeMint() calls totalSupply() in its supply checks.
totalSupply() reads supplyCounter.current().
withdraw() invokes Address.sendValue to push ETH to the owner.
Local balance caches the contract balance used by withdraw().
withdraw() resolves the owner through _owner().
tokenURI() calls the internal _tokenURI helper.
setBaseURI() calls the internal _setBaseURI helper.
Loop counter i drives the mint for-loop.
Loop counter i drives the freeMint for-loop.
_owner() obtains the base interface through base().
base().__owner() forwards to the base implementation getter.
_mint delegates to base().__mint on the implementation contract.
_tokenURI delegates to base().__tokenURI.
extensionURI is appended in tokenURI() output.
tokenURI() reads extensionURI to build the returned string.
_fallback performs a raw delegatecall to the implementation address, allowing arbitrary delegated execution.
Address.sendValue performs an external CALL transferring control to the owner, a reentrancy vector mitigated by nonReentrant.
Base mint path can trigger the configurable self delegatecall hook _beforeTokenTransfer during token operations.
burn() authorizes msg.sender via _isApprovedOrOwner before burning.
